stats.title: Public stats
stats.metaDescription: Live first-party analytics for SaaS Made Free: page views, AI citations and crawlers, prompt copies and votes — published in the open.
stats.intro: First-party analytics, self-queried and published on purpose. No cookies, no third-party trackers, refreshed every minute. Everything collected is on this page — there is no private dashboard.
stats.liveUnavailable: Live stats are unreachable right now. The catalogue figures below are still exact; the live counters will be back shortly.
stats.visitorDaysNote: Daily unique visitors summed over 7 days. Our daily-salted IP hashes cannot be linked across days — by design — so a returning visitor counts once per day.
stats.aiVisitorsNote: Humans who clicked through to this site from an AI answer — the closest thing to a real citation.
stats.crawlersNote: Counted twice on purpose: by our own Worker in front of the pages (edge) and by Cloudflare's analytics API (cf). Two sources keep each other honest.
